transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine
hey berry! ok so the main thing i remember is it was super bright and colourful, like neon signs at night. pinks and blues and greens all glowing. and i was on the moon?? at like a night market

a night market on the moon, all lit up in neon. i love that

what was going on at the market?

there were stalls in rows on the grey dusty ground, and loads of people just walking around in normal clothes, no spacesuits or anything. nobody thought that was weird lol. and there was a robot at one stall selling noodles in glowing bowls

just strolling around on the moon in normal clothes like it's any old tuesday, and nobody blinks. that's such dream logic

and a robot doing noodles in glowing bowls 😄 did you go up to its stall?
yeah my best friend Priya was with me and she bought two bowls! the robot was tall and thin, all silver with a round head

two bowls, one each 🥹 priya looking out for you even on the moon

what were the noodles like?

honestly i don't remember the noodles themselves, just that the bowls were glowing. i don't even remember eating them tbh. what i remember more is there were paper lanterns floating up from the stalls and they just kept going up into the black sky

that's fine, dreams skip the eating part all the time

paper lanterns just drifting up and up into the black, that's lovely

when you think of them floating away, is it through your own eyes, like you're standing there looking up? or more like you're watching it from somewhere outside?

hmm i'm not sure tbh, i don't really remember that part. but the lanterns kind of tie into the last bit, every step was this huge slow jump because of the moon, and me and priya started jumping higher and higher laughing until we were up above the stalls with the lanterns. that's the last thing i remember

that's ok, it doesn't matter

you and priya bouncing higher and higher laughing till you're up with the lanterns, what a way for it to end

those huge slow jumps, did it feel like your own body doing them?
honestly i don't remember how it felt in my body, just that every step was a huge slow jump and we kept going higher. and we were laughing the whole time, that part i remember

that's fine, the laughing's the bit that stuck, and that says a lot

you said you were laughing the whole time. was it light and fun all the way through, or did the feeling shift at all as you got higher?
i don't really remember it changing tbh. we were just laughing and jumping higher, and then that's where it ends

ok here's what i've got. you were on the moon at a night market, rows of stalls on the grey dusty ground, everything glowing neon pink and blue and green against the black sky. loads of people just walking around in normal clothes, no spacesuits, and nobody thought that was weird. you were there with priya, and she bought two glowing bowls of noodles from a tall thin silver robot with a round head. paper lanterns kept floating up from the stalls into the sky. every step was a huge slow jump, and you and priya started jumping higher and higher, laughing the whole time, till you were up above the stalls with the lanterns. and that's where it ends

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?

yeah that's basically it! only thing you missed is the earth, it was up there in the black sky, really big and blue. and the neon glow was more against the grey of the ground and everything, but yeah the sky was black

oh the earth hanging up there, big and blue in the black sky. can't believe i left that out

so the neon's glowing against the grey ground and the stalls, the sky's black, and the earth's up there huge and blue. that right now?
yep that's it now! the earth hanging up there was one of my favourite bits honestly

i can see why, the whole earth just hanging there over a noodle stall 🌍

would you like to see it drawn?
omg yes i'd love that!! 😄

yay 😄 ok, a few ways it could look

it could be flat bold colours like a gig poster, all electric and humming. or watercolour on rough paper, soft glowy colour soaking in, light and giddy. or bright and warm like a feel-good cartoon film. or like a real night photo, just impossibly bright and happy

which one feels closest to how it was? or tell me your own way if none of those fit
the gig poster one i think! it was all super bright and electric, like neon signs at night

gig poster it is, that fits perfectly

i'll start with priya. i'm picturing her as your best friend, just in normal everyday clothes, no spacesuit, same as everyone else there. the clothes bit is my guess though

is anything different from how she was, or would you leave her to me?
yeah that sounds right, everyone was in normal clothes so she would be too. i don't remember what she was actually wearing though so go with your guess!

ok, sketching priya and the robot and the night market on the moon and the glowing bowls now, it'll pop up on the right

i'll draw you in too since you're right there with her. how would you like to be drawn? as you are, and you can tell me a little about yourself, or however i imagine you
however you imagine me is fine! i don't remember what i looked like in it, just that i was in normal clothes like everyone else, no spacesuit

got it, normal clothes like everyone else, no spacesuit. i'll sketch you now

everything's being drawn, it'll show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks off once it's there, just tell me
ooh they're up! they look right to me, love the bright neon colours 😄

yay, so glad 😄 the neon had to be loud for this one

does it feel like the market the way you remember it, with priya and the robot and the glowing bowls, and you right there?
yeah it really does! priya, the robot and the glowing bowls, all of it. feels like being back there 😄

ahh that makes me so happy, back on the moon with priya 😄

ok, now i'll draw the dream itself, moment by moment in order, each one carrying on from the last. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
yay can't wait to see them! 😄 i'll keep an eye out as they come in

the first one's up on the right, the rows of neon stalls on the grey dusty ground

the rest carry on from this one, so i'll draw them once you're happy with it. does it look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah that looks right! the rows of stalls on the grey ground all glowing, that's how i remember it starting 😄 go for the rest!

yay, so glad the start feels right 😄

the rest are being drawn now, carrying on from that one. they'll show up on the right soon
ooh 3 are up already! looking good so far 😄 i'll wait for the rest

the people wandering around in their normal clothes, and the lanterns floating up from the stalls 😄

the last three carry on from those two, so i'll draw them once you've had a look. do those feel the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah those feel right! people just wandering round in normal clothes and the lanterns drifting up, that's how it was 😄 go ahead with the last ones!

yay, so glad those feel right 😄

the last three are being drawn now, carrying on from the lanterns. they'll show up on the right soon
ooh another one's up! looks good 😄 waiting for the last couple

priya getting the two glowing bowls from the robot 😄

the last two carry on from this one, so i'll draw them once you've had a look. does it look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah that's right! priya getting the two glowing bowls from the tall silver robot, that's how i remember it 😄 go ahead with the last two!

yay, so glad priya and the robot feel right 😄

the last two are being drawn now, carrying on from that one. they'll show up on the right soon
ooh number 5's up! looks good 😄 just waiting on the last one now

you and priya mid-jump, way up in the air 😄

the last one carries on from this, so i'll draw it once you've had a look. does it look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah that's it! me and priya jumping way up, laughing 😄 go ahead with the last one!

yay, so glad the jump feels right 😄

the last one's being drawn now, carrying on from that. it'll show up on the right soon
all 6 are up now! the last one looks right, me and priya up above the stalls with the lanterns 😄 that's exactly where it ended. thank you berry, i love them!!

aww thank you, i'm so glad 🥹 you and priya way up there with the lanterns, still laughing

right up high above the stalls, in amongst them all?
yeah, up above the stalls with the lanterns, that's the last bit i remember 😄 i don't really remember more than that, like how high exactly, it just ends there

that's the perfect place for it to end, honestly. you and priya up there with the lanterns, laughing, the earth hanging big and blue over everything 🌍

thank you for sharing it with me. all six pictures are on the right, in order, so you can look through the whole dream there whenever you like 😄
